notes.title: Reverence Alpha 2.0 Released
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/xlc1mq9rXvE

The long awaited update is finally here. The game is still very much in an alpha state, but this patch brings many new changes including:

Action Frames:
This is the biggest addition of the patch. Clicking LMB or RMB play a configurable attack animation (clicking and holding still triggers total control). This should make the game much more intuitive for beginners.

Precision Control: 
Hold E to control the position of your hand rather than swinging from your shoulder. Less powerful but more control

Improved blocking:
Blocking works more accurately now.

Improved VR Controls:
Hands stay more 1:1 to motion controllers

Camera Fixes: 
The camera stays level with the ground.

There are a ton of other things I changed/added, but I am bad about writing down everything.

notes.title: Alpha 1.02 Patch - 3 new weapons and console
notes.content:
3 new weapons added this week:

Medieval Warhammer
Roman Gladius
Flamberge

In addition, we've added a development console which you can pull down in game by pressing the ~ key.

A few notable commands in this initial deployment of the dev console are
SetStartingBlood (you can set the starting health of the player)
SetGravity (Set the world gravity)
HeadChopThreshold (Set the minimum force needed to decaptitate players

I will continue adding new commands, and welcome any requests for new commands to offer further customization.

notes.title: First Alpha Patch - v1.01 - Bardiche Added!
notes.content:
Thank you for the early support and the input on the forum. We will be trying to release a new weapon every week. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26109144/c0d7f7395990d1bb170734739485ac825a7ee458.gif[/img]

This week is the Bardiche, a powerful polearm capable of chopping opponents. 

Changelog:
-Bardiche added
-Wooden Pitchfork rescaled to be more realistic.
-Z (toggle Fly) disabled - all developer buttons will be moved to console commands

In progress is a implementation of a console (~) so you can enter different developer commands to do things such as tweaking the properties of weapons and health of players if you are the host of a game. Along with several bug fixes of course.

Also, thanks to all the requests on the forum, we will be begin prioritizing work on the motion controller integration next week.
